Ritika Gupta
Data Engineer | Delhi NCR
ritika.gupta973@example.com | +91 9881188867

Results-driven data engineer with strong experience building reliable ETL pipelines, optimizing analytics models, and enabling self-serve data for business stakeholders. Experienced in financial and e-commerce domains with a focus on SQL-driven transformations, orchestration, and cloud data warehouses. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 15 days.

Experience

Saffron Bank — Apr 2022 - Present
Data Engineer | Remote
- Implemented end-to-end ETL pipelines using SQL and dbt to transform transaction and customer datasets, reducing nightly pipeline runtime by 40% and enabling same-day reporting for fraud analytics.
- Designed and optimized Snowflake schemas and partitioning patterns for high-cardinality financial feeds, cutting query costs by 30% while improving average query latency from 4s to 1.8s.
- Built dbt models and tests covering critical metrics; introduced CI checks that caught schema drift in 2 production incidents and prevented data regressions.
- Collaborated with product and risk teams in Agile sprints, tracked work in Jira, and improved deployment frequency by introducing modular dbt packages.

Wipro — Dec 2021 - Mar 2022
Big Data Engineer | Hybrid
- Developed Python data ingestion scripts and PySpark jobs to load streaming and batch sources into Snowflake, increasing upstream data availability from 6 hours to 45 minutes.
- Tuned Spark configurations and optimized PySpark transformations to reduce cluster hours by 25% for nightly ETL workloads.
- Implemented automated validation routines and integrated jobs with Jira for change tracking, reducing rollbacks by 20%.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies and collaborated with cross-functional teams to stabilize data products during a high-volume migration.

UrbanPantry — Apr 2021 - Nov 2021
Data Engineer | On-site
- Orchestrated daily and hourly workflows using Apache Airflow to process order, inventory, and delivery datasets, improving end-to-end data freshness from 3 hours to 30 minutes.
- Built Python and PySpark transformations to cleanse and enrich clickstream and transaction data before loading into Snowflake for analytics and BI.
- Implemented monitoring DAGs and alerting, which reduced incident response time by 35% and improved SLA adherence.
- Worked in Agile teams, managed tasks in Jira, and collaborated with analytics stakeholders to deliver weekly business metrics.

Projects

- Customer Churn Feature Store: Built a dbt-based feature store for churn modeling using SQL and dbt models; reduced feature computation time by 50% and standardized feature definitions for modelers.
- Near-Real-Time Orders Pipeline: Implemented a PySpark streaming prototype to merge order events into Snowflake with Airflow orchestration, achieving sub-minute latency for high-priority events.

Skills

Languages: Python3, SQL
Big Data & ETL: Apache Spark, PySpark, Apache Airflow
Warehousing & Modeling: Snowflake, dbt
Tools & Processes: Jira, Agile

Education

CA, ICAI
